h1.en: Concrete plant illustrates the note on Electric Mixer Pump vs Diesel Mixer Pump
h1.zh: 「Concrete plant」用来说明电动搅拌泵一体机和柴油搅拌泵一体机有何不同

directAnswer.en: The integrated mixer and the diesel mixer are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai that mix and pump on one trailer. The electric page lists main motor 45 kW and mixer motor 14 kW, 21 m³/h and distance 100 m / 300 m. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_plant.
directAnswer.zh: 搅拌泵一体机和柴油搅拌泵一体机是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵，在同一拖车上搅拌并泵送。电动页标出主电机 45 kW、搅拌电机 14 kW、21 m³/h、距离 100 m / 300 m。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_plant。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_plant. The image subject is Concrete plant. The integrated mixer and the diesel mixer are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai that mix and pump on one trailer. Neither page is a mixing plant. Main unit weight: Integrated Mixer Pump lists 4500 kg. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump lists 4200 kg. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump lists entries that Integrated Mixer Pump does not: Diesel engine 4108 / 66–75 kW. Stone capacity (H / V, ≤ 1 inch) 100 / 300 m. 13 mm stone (H / V) 60 / 180 m. 24 mm stone (H / V) 40 / 120 m. Open /en/products/integrated-mixer-pump/ for Integrated Mixer Pump and /en/products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump/ for Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_plant。画面内容是Concrete plant。搅拌泵一体机和柴油搅拌泵一体机是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵，在同一拖车上搅拌并泵送。理论输送量：搅拌泵一体机标出 21 m³/h；柴油搅拌泵一体机标出 25 m³/h。系列说明：搅拌泵一体机标出 30 series with 400 mixer; 40/50 series with 500 mixer；柴油搅拌泵一体机标出 30 model with 400 mixer; 40/50 model with 500 mixer。搅拌泵一体机有、柴油搅拌泵一体机没有的行：主电机 / 搅拌电机 45 kW / 14 kW；输送距离（水平/垂直） 100 m / 300 m；最大骨料粒径 4 cm and below；输送管内径 100 / 125 mm。看搅拌泵一体机请打开 /zh/products/integrated-mixer-pump/，看柴油搅拌泵一体机请打开 /zh/products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump/。

body.en: The electric page lists main motor 45 kW and mixer motor 14 kW, 21 m³/h and distance 100 m / 300 m. Theoretical output: Integrated Mixer Pump lists 21 m³/h. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump lists 25 m³/h. Series note: Integrated Mixer Pump lists 30 series with 400 mixer. 40/50 series with 500 mixer. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump lists 30 model with 400 mixer. 40/50 model with 500 mixer. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 电动页标出主电机 45 kW、搅拌电机 14 kW、21 m³/h、距离 100 m / 300 m。外形尺寸：搅拌泵一体机标出 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm；柴油搅拌泵一体机标出 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm。同一标题下数值相同的有：最大出口压力两边都是 23 MPa；料斗容积两边都是 0.4 m³。柴油搅拌泵一体机有、搅拌泵一体机没有的行：柴油机 4108 / 66–75 kW；细石输送（水平/垂直） 100 / 300 m；13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 60 / 180 m；24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 40 / 120 m。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: The diesel page lists engine 4108 / 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h and three stone rows, starting at 100 / 300 m. Dimensions: Integrated Mixer Pump lists 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump lists 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm. The same shown value on a shared label: Max. outlet pressure is 23 MPa on both pages. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³ on both pages. Integrated Mixer Pump lists entries that Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump does not: Main motor / mixer motor 45 kW / 14 kW. Pumping distance (H / V) 100 m / 300 m. Max. aggregate size 4 cm and below. Delivery pipe diameter 100 / 125 mm. A mixer note about 400 and 500 mixers does not add a second full specification table. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 柴油页标出发动机 4108 / 66–75 kW、25 m³/h 和三行石子距离，第一行为 100 / 300 m。整机重量：搅拌泵一体机标出 4500 kg；柴油搅拌泵一体机标出 4200 kg。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。关于 400 和 500 搅拌机的系列说明，并没有再附一套完整规格表。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Integrated Mixer Pump list the same theoretical output as Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump?
question.zh: 搅拌泵一体机和柴油搅拌泵一体机的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Integrated Mixer Pump lists 21 m³/h. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump lists 25 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_plant.
answer.zh: 不一样。搅拌泵一体机标出 21 m³/h。柴油搅拌泵一体机标出 25 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_plant画面里印出的数字。

question.zh: 搅拌泵一体机和柴油搅拌泵一体机的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. Integrated Mixer Pump lists 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump lists 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_plant.
answer.zh: 不一样。搅拌泵一体机标出 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm。柴油搅拌泵一体机标出 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_plant画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: No. Integrated Mixer Pump lists 4500 kg. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump lists 4200 kg. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_plant.

question.en: On this row: Why is main motor / mixer motor missing on Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump?
question.zh: 为什么柴油搅拌泵一体机没有主电机 / 搅拌电机？

answer.en: The Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump page does not list that label. Integrated Mixer Pump lists 45 kW / 14 kW. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_plant.
answer.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机这一页没有标出这个标题。搅拌泵一体机标出的是 45 kW / 14 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_plant画面里印出的数字。
